observation.visible_scene: A close-up, eye-level view of a wavy, reflective corrugated metal grate laid across the top of a green striped box decorated with white snowflake motifs and a metal latch at the front center. Resting on the grate is an irregular, lumpy brown object covered in glittery specks, roughly centered in the frame. In the upper-right corner the dark curved rim of a pan or pot is visible, and it casts a sharp dark shadow onto the right side of the grate. The blurred background shows green foliage and a pink object.
visible_changes: The brown glittery object holds the same position, shape, and orientation from the first frame to the last; no translation, rotation, or deformation is observable.
The dark pan rim in the upper right and the shadow it throws on the grate remain fixed in place throughout the excerpt.
Background elements (foliage, pink object) and the grate/box stay aligned frame to frame, indicating no camera pan or zoom.
No new object enters and none leaves; the scene is essentially a still shot for the duration of the segment.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the pan rim is held by a person or mounted, and what (if any) action it performs before or after this cropped window.
Whether the brown object is food, a craft piece, or another material, and whether any heating or manipulation occurs outside this segment.
uncertain_details: Possible very slight flickering of specular highlights on the glittery surface and the metal grate due to lighting, but no clear motion is supported.
Minor sub-pixel jitter, if any, is too small to distinguish from camera stability.
